evidence.claim: In November 1861, Colonel Richard J. Oglesby brought Union troops to Bloomfield under General Ulysses S. Grant’s orders to capture M. Jeff Thompson.
evidence.quote: Acting on instructions from General Ulysses S. Grant, Colonel Richard J. Oglesby led his troops to Bloomfield with a clear objective: find and capture the 'Swamp Fox' of the Confederacy, M. Jeff Thompson.

evidence.claim: Confederate forces had abandoned the town. Ten soldiers who were printers requested its local press; Oglesby approved, and they produced the first Stars and Stripes.
evidence.quote: Finding the town abandoned by Confederate forces, ten Union soldiers—printers by trade—requested permission to requisition the local printing press. With Oglesby's approval, the first edition of the Stars and Stripes was born.
